run_precompute_enumerate_surface: run the CLI script to enumerate and pickle surface structures for a given bulk index
create_enumerate_surfaces_for_saving: create a function call to enumerate all symmetrically distinct surfaces of a bulk crystal structure
build_standardize_bulk: build a standardized conventional unit cell structure from an ASE Atoms bulk object
test_is_structure_invertible: test whether a pymatgen Structure has z-direction symmetry that makes top and bottom equivalent
refactor_flip_struct: refactor a pymatgen Structure by flipping it upside down along the z-axis for surface analysis
